newsitem.title: USA: Senators ask U.S. Justice to review LA Fed branch.
newsitem.headline: Senators ask U.S. Justice to review LA Fed branch.

text.p: Two Democratic senators on Monday urged Attorney General Janet Reno to look into recent allegations of financial improprieties at the Los Angeles branch of the San Francisco Federal Reserve Bank.
Sens. Harry Reid of Nevada and Byron Dorgan of North Dakota wrote to Reno: "We believe these disturbing reports merit greater attention from the Department of Justice."
The allegations were raised in a draft General Accounting Office report to Congress in August that questioned the bank's accounting and internal controls.
GAO, the accounting arm of Congress said cash reports "were prepared incorrectly at the direction of the L.A. bank's management."
A Justice Department spokesman said: "We're looking into the inquiry that the senators have made."
